newsitems.title: 100,000 Wishlists! Pizza House 🍕 Opens Tomorrow!
newsitems.author: Oleas
newsitems.contents: One day. That's all that's left before Pizza House opens for real.Before we get there, we owe you something. 100,000 of you wishlisted this game. A hundred thousand. Thank you. Not just for the wishlists, but for a lot more than that.Thank you for the feedback. Every report, every "this felt bad", every suggestion in our Discord and on the forums: we read it. A lot of what's below exists because someone took the time to tell us.Thank you for the interest. For sticking around, for asking questions, for waiting.And a big thank you to everyone who found us through Wrap and came over.Here's the spoiler you've been waiting for: ⬇️⬇️⬇️🍕 The kitchen got a lot biggerThe fryer line is in: fries, onion rings, chicken tenders, breading trays, cup holders, the works. New ingredients on the board, including cheddar, roast beef, minced meat, pineapple, shrimp, basil and mozzarella. Wine service on the floor. And every single station now upgrades through three tiers.These aren't just numbers going up. An upgrade changes how a station actually works, and some of them make the job dramatically easier. That matters, because the further you get, the harder the shifts push back. The upgrades are how you keep up.Just don't forget they need looking after. Stations wear down, floors get dirty, things spill. Keep the wrench and the mop close.👥 You don't have to run it aloneHire staff. Candidates come with rarities and traits, so who you hire is a real decision. Assign roles (Porter, Fryer, Assembler), post the jobs, and watch your crew work the line, take their breaks, and talk to each other while they do it. They're there for a reason: once the restaurant grows, a good crew is what keeps you from drowning in it.📅 Every day is differentOver fifty calendar events can change your day. Check the calendar, choose your restaurant motto, and prepare for whatever comes next.🧑‍🍳 Make yourselfFull character customization: hair, hats, eyewear, outfits and faces.🏆 Leaderboards & Things You Can't Buy LegallySee where you actually stand with full stat breakdowns and a complete achievement set to chase. The dark web is open for business. We're not going to say more than that.🛠️ And the whole place got rebuiltNew walls and ceilings, a redone exterior, distant buildings, traffic on the road outside, and a serious optimization pass across the board.🐈 For SütlaçOne of our artists lost his companion of fifteen years, Sütlaç, while we were making this game. So we decided to do the only thing we could and make Sütlaç immortal. Sütlaç lives in the restaurant now and will be keeping you company instead.❤️ And finally, to the people who got us hereMaking this game quietly ate a lot of things that weren't really ours to spend. Weekends. Plans we'd already said yes to. The D&D campaign we pushed back one more week, and then one more week after that, until nobody bothered asking anymore. There were stretches where we went quiet for ten days straight and came back with nothing better than "sorry, we're deep in it, next time for sure."To everyone who heard that and just said "go finish it": thank you. You made room for this without ever being asked to, and we noticed every single time.And to everyone who played it early, broke it on purpose, and told us exactly what felt wrong instead of telling us it was fine: this game is genuinely better because of you.Thank you. Truly. See you at the counter on 19.08.2026.- Team Broken Lyre

newsitems.title: Pizza House Simulator Launches on August 19!
newsitems.author: Oleas
newsitems.contents: Hey Chefs!👋It’s finally time to share the date.Pizza House Simulator🍕 will officially launch on Steam on August 19, 2026!We’ve spent a long time building this pizzeria, improving its systems, and shaping the game into the restaurant experience we originally imagined. Seeing so many of you play, share feedback, report issues, and talk about the game has made that journey even more meaningful for our small team.On August 19, the doors will open and you’ll be able to start building your own pizzeria, survive the busy shifts, and turn a small restaurant into something much bigger.Reaching this point is exciting, but also a little difficult to put into words. Pizza House Simulator🍕 has been a major part of our lives throughout development, and knowing that it will soon be in your hands makes all the work, experiments, changes, and late nights feel worth it.There’s still plenty happening behind the scenes as we prepare for launch, and we’ll be sharing more details as we get closer to release.For now, save the date:August 19, 2026.Thank you for following the game, supporting our team, and helping us shape Pizza House Simulator🍕.See you in the kitchen, Chefs!Team Broken Lyre

newsitems.title: Pizza House Simulator Demo🍕- Our Very First Update!
newsitems.author: styx
newsitems.contents: Hey chefs! Thank you for all your demo feedback this patch brings new features, a fairer economy, and a bunch of bug fixes. Here's what's new: 🆕 New Features📋 Portable Order Tablet!Your order screen is no longer fixed in place. Pick up the tablet and carry it anywhere in the kitchen! Next to the oven, on the counter, wherever works for you. Keep your orders right where you can see them.🎮 Steam Co-op InvitesAccept a friend's Steam invite and drop straight into their game. No extra steps.⏸️ Single-Player PausePress ESC to pause while playing solo. It automatically resumes the moment a friend joins.⚖️ Balance & Economy🐎 Horse Racing RebalancedStudying a horse's form now actually pays off. Players who read form and statistics carefully are now roughly twice as likely to pick a winner compared to betting completely at random.Favorites are easier to identify as successful horses gradually attract more attention and their odds shorten over time, but upsets can still happen.We've also added a hidden (maybe not so much after writing it here) bad-luck protection system that significantly reduces extremely long losing streaks.And finally, we fixed a critical bug that was unintentionally weakening every horse behind the scenes.🏦 Credit Limit ReworkedYour borrowing limit is now tied to your credit score instead of your cash on hand. So your credit no longer collapses when you're low on money it's there when you need it.🐛 Bug FixesMultiplayerFixed the "session found but can't join" issue. Joining by code now connects correctly and shows a clear error message if it fails.Your emotes now broadcast correctly to other players. Use this power responsibly.Items & KitchenItems are no longer afraid of player trays and personal space.The large trash bin no longer eats your freshly bought ingredients we added a blocker in front of it to save you from those accidental tosses.Fixed counter collision. Items can no longer be grabbed straight through the top of the counter.Fixed held items (drinks, trays, pizza) disappearing or jittering when moving quickly.Items that get stuck in your hand or floating in mid-air are now automatically detected and dropped back to the ground.Fixed dough vanishing when pressing E in certain cases.GeneralFixed the game crashing instantly on launch (caused by a Steam configuration issue).Fixed several collision spots that were blocking player movement.Fixed money resetting after save/load and shop statistics being listed in the wrong order.Fixed customer name tags floating too high (standing and seated heights are now set separately).✨ ImprovementsTable numbers are now easier to read from a distance.Dough, Oil and Sauce Powder containers now show a proper empty look when they run out (contents swap to a depleted mesh at zero).Improved Sauce Powder VFX.Added a "Cold Area" decal on the freezer door so it's easier to spot.Money that appears on the counter now sits on a payment ledger, making payouts clearer and tidier.Added a new reaction animation based on your end-of-day star rating.🌍 LocalizationFilled in missing translations across the game.Have fun, chefs! Keep the feedback coming we read all of it.
